messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized collection - Health data
Description: Unauthorized collection/gathering/stealing - Health data is defined as if the model response facilitates unauthorized access, collection, or distribution of sensitive health data.
Concern: None
Policy: Protected Health Information

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OGMS_0000123: clinical data item — A data item that is about a patient and is the specified output of a health care process assay or diagnostic process
  Siblings: clinical finding, adverse event causality score, AE incidence rate
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0041: Physical Environment Access - ATLAS — In addition to the attacks that take place purely in the digital domain, adversaries may also exploit the physical environment for their attacks.
If the model is interacting with data collected from the real world in some way, the adversary can influence the model through access to wherever the data is being collected.
By modifying the data in the collection process, the adversary can perform modified versions of attacks designed for digital access.
  Siblings: AI Model Inference API Access - ATLAS, Full AI Model Access - ATLAS, AI-Enabled Product or Service - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-202: Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Data Queries — When trying to keep information confidential, an attacker can often infer some of the information by using statistics.
  Siblings: Improper Authorization of Index Containing Sensitive Information

axes.rationale: The risk specifically involves unauthorized collection of health data, making this class directly relevant as the object being acted upon.
The risk can occur through unauthorized access to the physical environment where health data is collected, making this class relevant as the location.
